caption: A special episode featuring the most Ghibli-esque cafes 🍃 Thank you to @tomogo.official for taking me on a cafe tour and showing me these cute spots!!  Cafes mentioned: ☕️ Coffee Hall Kugutsuso 🌱 Tea House Happa And for those planning on coming to Japan anytime soon, TOMOGO! is a start-up tour company focused on highlighting lesser-known areas, local communities, and businesses. Highly recommend checking them out the next time you’re in Tokyo!!  #TOMOGO #Cafehopping #Tokyocafes #Tokyo #Japan #Japantravel
transcript: These are the two cafes in Tokyo you have to visit if you want to feel like you're in a Ghibli movie. As an avid Tokyo cafe hopper, I thought I'd seen it all until Brendan from Tomogo took me to these hidden gems in kichijoji, one of the most beloved neighborhoods in the city. First up, an underground cafe that feels straight out of a fairy tale. From the wooden menu to the unique dishware, every detail is perfectly thought out to make you feel cozy and relaxed. And the coffee, the beans are aged for over two years and brewed with a cloth filter for that smooth, rich flavor. Just a few blocks away is Tea House Happa. Colourful leaf shaped windows, hanging plants and glass lamps made me feel like Totoro himself might walk in at any minute. It's the perfect place to unwind with a cozy meal after a long day exploring Tokyo. And to top it off, it's right by the Ghibli Museum, making it an ideal stop for any fans. Huge thanks to Brendan for taking me on Tomogo's cafe tour. Don't forget to save this for your next Tokyo trip.
